title: User Registration and Login Flow

registration: User → RegisterSrv: GET/POST /RegisterSrv (username, mobile, email, address, pincode, password, confirmPassword)
alt [passwords match]: RegisterSrv → UserServiceImpl: new UserServiceImpl()
UserServiceImpl → Database: SELECT * FROM user WHERE email=?
alt [email already registered]: UserServiceImpl → RegisterSrv: return 'Email Id Already Registered!'
alt [email not registered]: UserServiceImpl → Database: INSERT INTO user VALUES(email, name, mobile, address, pincode, password)
login_customer: UserServiceImpl → Database: SELECT * FROM user WHERE email=? AND password=?
UserServiceImpl → Database: SELECT * FROM user WHERE email=? AND password=?
Database → UserServiceImpl: ResultSet → UserBean(name, mobile, email, address, pincode, password)
alt [credentials invalid]: LoginSrv → User: forward to login.jsp?message=Login Denied
login_admin: alt [invalid admin]: LoginSrv → User: include login.jsp?message=Login Denied
logout: LogoutSrv → User: forward to login.jsp?message=Successfully Logged Out!

key_relationships: UserServiceImpl depends_on DBUtil (static utility for DB connections)
UserServiceImpl depends_on MailMessage (static utility for emails)
UserBean is a plain data bean with fields: name, mobile, email, address, pinCode, password

UserService_interface_methods: registerUser(String, Long, String, String, int, String): String

conditions_and_branches: Registration: if password != confirmPassword → return 'Password not matching!' without calling service
Registration: if email already in DB → return 'Email Id Already Registered!'
Registration: if INSERT succeeds (k>0) → send confirmation email via MailMessage
Login: if usertype=='admin' → hardcoded credential check (admin@gmail.com/admin), no DB query
Login: if usertype!='admin' (customer) → DB credential check via isValidCredential
Login customer: if 'valid' → fetch UserBean and set session; else redirect with error
important_notes: No password hashing — passwords stored and compared in plaintext. Admin credentials are hardcoded in LoginSrv. UserServiceImpl is instantiated via 'new' in each servlet (no dependency injection / no Spring). DBUtil is a static utility class. MailMessage.registrationSuccess sends HTML welcome email with promo code 'ELLISON500'. Session invalidation on logout sets attributes to null rather than calling session.invalidate().
